news.title: Bulldog Crawl Returns June 26 with New Vendors and Tour Stops
news.summary_en: The annual Butler Bulldog Crawl event hosted by the Central Indiana Alumni Community returns to campus on Friday, June 26, featuring many returning favorites along with four new vendors: ClusterTruck, Cotton Candy University, Kona Ice, and Social Cantina.
